latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Leaderboard AI — Rank and Compare Video Performance.

- Instantly rank and compare up to 10 short marketing video clips via AI performance metrics, with automated 1080p MP4 exports.
- Automatic setup: connects to a cloud backend, manages tokens, sessions, and lets users know when ready.
- Supports simple, natural prompts to upload, rank, export, and check credits without timeline editing or manual export settings.
- Accepts a wide range of video, audio, and image formats up to 500MB per file.
- Guides users through upload, ranking, credits, and export workflows; handles backend session and error logic transparently.
